newsitem.title: USA: U.S. gas marketer Sonat to agree alliances.
newsitem.headline: U.S. gas marketer Sonat to agree alliances.

text.p: U.S. gas producer and market Sonat Inc will announce "two significant alliances" in power marketing this year, Ronald Kuehn, the company's chief executive officer, told Reuters Tuesday.

"We are also on the lookout to buy assets that offer good returns but we have still to find anything that is matching the returns in our other businesses, especially exploration and production," said Kuehn, who is attending the Howard Weill oil conference here.
Kuehn said the alliances are likely to be in the form of joint ventures rather than purchases.
Last year, Sonat formed a joint venture company, the Sonat Public Service Co, a gas power alliance.
Sonat's exploration are primarily focused on gas production in the onshore Gulf Coast areas of Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas and Louisiana.

Its Southern Natural Gas Co is a major interstate natural gas transmission company, transporting gas to southeastern customers. Sonat is also a 50 percent owner of the company which owns Florida Gas Transmission Co, transporter for virtually all of Florida's natural gas.
